title: INTRYGUE: Induction-Aware Entropy Gating for Reliable RAG Uncertainty Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2603.21607v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances LLM performance, it does not eliminate hallucinations, making accurate detection essential. Uncertainty-based methods are attractive for this purpose because they can be integrated into real-world pipelines with little overhead. One of the most widely used uncertainty signals is predictive entropy. We show, however, that entropy can be unreliable in RAG settings and trace this limitation to two opposing internal effects. Induction heads, which copy patterns from earlier context, causally support correct responses and lower predictive entropy, but they also appear to co-activate entropy neurons that push it back up. As a result, correct, context-grounded responses can still receive high uncertainty scores. translated_title: INTRYGUE：面向可靠RAG不确定性估计的归纳感知熵门控方法
translated_abstract: 尽管检索增强生成（RAG）提升了大语言模型的性能，但它并不能消除幻觉，因此准确的幻觉检测至关重要。基于不确定性的方法因其能以极小的开销集成到实际应用流程中而颇具吸引力。预测熵是最广泛使用的不确定性信号之一。然而，我们发现在RAG场景下熵可能并不可靠，并将这一局限性追溯到两种相反的内部效应：归纳头会从先前的上下文中复制模式，因果性地支持正确响应并降低预测熵，但它们似乎也会共同激活将熵推高的熵神经元。结果是，正确的、基于上下文的响应仍可能获得较高的不确定性评分。为解决这一问题，我们提出了INTRYGUE（归纳感知熵门控不确定性估计方法），这是一种无需训练、基于机制分析的方法，通过对预测熵进行门控……
tldr: 该论文揭示了RAG场景下预测熵因归纳头（降低熵）与熵神经元（推高熵）两种相反内部效应而变得不可靠，并提出无需训练、基于机制分析的INTRYGUE方法，通过归纳感知的熵门控实现更可靠的RAG不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that predictive entropy becomes unreliable in RAG due to two opposing internal effects—induction heads lowering entropy and co-activated entropy neurons pushing it up—and proposes INTRYGUE, a training-free, mechanistically grounded method that gates predictive entropy for reliable RAG uncertainty estimation.
